test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In January 2023, ___________ was appointed as the next Director General in the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Dev Dutt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vikram Dev Dutt was appointed as the** next Director General **in the **Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)** in January 2023.
 
• He is a **senior Indian Administrative Service** (IAS) officer from the **1991 batch** of the Gujarat cadre.
 
• He has held various positions in the central and state governments, including as the **Principal Secretary** in the** Gujarat Chief Minister's Office** and as the **Joint Secretary in the Ministry of Civil Aviation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arvind Singh**, is currently serving as the **Chairman **of the** Airports Authority of India (AAI).**

 
 
• He was previously the Managing Director of the **Bangalore International Airport Limited (BIAL).**
 
 
 
• **MR synerm** is a MD of **Indian Tourism development corporation.**
 
 
• **​**He is an experienced** IAS officer **belonging to the Assam-Meghalaya Cadre's 2002 Batch.
 
 
 
• **V Vidyavathi **is the **first woman** to be appointed as the** Director General of Police** (DGP) in** Karnataka.**
